easyPrerequisites:
Soul Diviner doesn't have summoning sickness.
You control another nontoken non-Human creature that doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it or enter with +1/+1 counters on it.
description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the additional creature
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it and removing the +1/+1 counter from the additional creature, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat
